It appears that the 'arabic_reshaper' module is not installed in your Python environment. You can install it using pip by running the following command: 

```
pip install arabic-reshaper
```

Once the installation is complete, you can use the module to reshape Arabic text. For example:

```python
import arabic_reshaper
from bidi.algorithm import get_display

arabic_text = "مرحبا بالعالم"
reshaped_text = arabic_reshaper.reshape(arabic_text)
display_text = get_display(reshaped_text)

print(display_text)
```

This should properly display the reshaped Arabic text in your Python console.
